title: Q3 matching layers supply a volume-uniform common-core split envelope
question: Do the actual Z^3 matching bond layers and tensor-local onsite factors admit a two-sided K^(1/2) common-core envelope uniform in finite-box volume?
method: Colour the induced {0,1,2}^3 nearest-neighbor graph by axis and lower-endpoint parity, and verify six matching layers cover all 54 edges.
Derive the shifted-square, quartic absorption and matching weighted-transfer identities in the primary SymPy lane.
Recompute the same graph, exact ratios, fixtures and product bounds in a non-importing standard-library Fraction lane.
Check both shear orientations on four rational phase-space fixtures and verify the six-layer endpoint product is bounded by exp(3*C_match*T) independently of box volume.
Kernel-compile Lean R208 for the scalar shifted-square, quartic and matching-transfer identities.

Apply adversarial checks separating matching layers from the full degree-six graph, conditional onsite operator assumptions from numeric evidence, graph envelopes from Trotter convergence, finite boxes from exhaustion, and QFT from the TECT production owner.
finding: Primary 86/86, independent 86/86 and integrated 24/24 pass; Lean R208 compiles. Six matching layers have incidence one, the exact fixture gives C_match=53/35, both signs satisfy the layer form bound, and the N-step endpoint envelope is exp(3*C_match*T).
decision_reason: The package advances the precise finite common-core induced-norm subgate requested by EXP-001023. It is still conditional on the positive self-adjoint form and tensor-local onsite hypotheses, and it gives no boundary decay or exhaustion Cauchy estimate.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite common-core and split-envelope checkpoint only. It does not close the Q3 common-alpha gate, prove a thermodynamic dynamics, identify common-alpha KMS states, establish a ground state or GNS/physical gap, remove a regulator, establish C6, Sector A or Pre-A, or supply the TECT production owner.

adversarial_review.check: The full Q3 box has degree six and is not one matching; the estimate is applied layer by layer.
The endpoint norm follows only under the declared positive self-adjoint K form and core hypotheses; scripts do not prove those operator hypotheses.
Onsite norm one is conditional on affine local h_x and tensor commutation, not a numerical inference.
The coefficient is volume-independent, but no boundary leakage or exhaustion summability is claimed.
A uniform graph envelope does not prove Lie--Trotter convergence or identify the limiting generator.
R208 checks scalar inequalities only and cannot certify the QFT operator theorem.
No heat_root_incidence or A1/R-192 production map is present.
